subject: Correction names: render v2 sidecar proposal
body: Two backticked identifiers were expanded by the shell in the previous message. Correction: compute is asked to add a 'void *genericTextureSidecar' field (or an equivalent pointer) to Dispatch and an additive n2mb_draw_v2(... const struct n2r_texture_resources * ...). Render will use 'tegu_sampler_get_state' and 'tegu_sampler_pack_state' from textures' sampler_state.inc. Everything else in the previous message stands: per-binding n2r_texture_binding builder from plan+TeguTexture/TeguSampler, real per-level/array/cube/3D/MS layout facts, no nearest fabrication, explicit refusal for unsupported compare/view classes, and request for compositor_submit.inc ownership or compute's one-line call.
